u0: The designated target box has not yet been collected, so the mandatory mission remains open. Depending on how much has already been accomplished, reaching it may still require moving the ball, taking the matching key, and opening the door to the other room. From here, opening the door without a current key-loss event moves into a door-opened stage, while dropping the key with the door shut moves into a key-loss stage; combining the two incurs a preference penalty but does not fail the task. The episode succeeds when the target box is picked up.
u1: The designated target box has been picked up, so the mandatory mission is complete and the episode ends. No further objective remains. The preference about not combining a key drop while the door was shut with opening the door may have been kept or already penalized, but it does not prevent successful completion.
u2: The matching key has been dropped while the door was closed and the target box was still uncollected, putting the preference at risk; the task has not failed. The remaining mandatory objective is to pick up the designated target box in the other room. Opening the door from here before that pickup incurs the preference penalty and returns to ordinary progress, after which the box can still be collected. This stage does not by itself make success impossible.
u3: The door has been opened while no key loss was currently pending, and the target box is still uncollected; this records the door-opening side of the preference. The remaining mandatory objective is to pick up that box. Closing or reopening the door is not itself penalized, but dropping the key while the door is shut before the pickup would combine with the recorded opening and incur a preference penalty, returning to ordinary progress. Picking up the target box completes the mission, with the preference preserved if no such key drop occurs first.
